title: 第十四章 过气名人上热搜了
slug: 不正经的异世界攻略手册
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“德兰克，这两年多亏了有你的努力啊，从一个小小的杂志社，到现在的大集团，我都没想到变化能这么大。”

“这也多亏了您的帮助，卡梅尔部长。”德兰克说道。

“呵呵，我只是起到了辅助作用而已。”卡梅尔淡淡笑道。

“只是，之前那样的事，最好还是不要再出现了，你也知道，为了给你压下来，王宫那边我都跑断腿了。”他又接着说道。

“是...还请放心，我们现在也在严格把控内容质量，保证不会再出现类似事故。”德兰克说道。

他们一起朝楼下走去，来到宴会大厅。

卡梅尔叹了口气：“唉，也还好给当初那位祖宗安顿下来了，当初可给我们惹了不少麻烦，想起他就头疼...”

“是啊...他...”德兰克话还没说完，宴会厅那边就传来了一声撕心裂肺的惨叫。

“怎么回事？”

他们连忙一起走了过去。

进了人群，还听到一声喝骂：

“下次再见面，给你另一只手一起跺了！”

罗文此时躺在地上，捂着手惨叫着，而当德兰克和卡梅尔看清楚那个拿着餐刀的人后，顿时就两眼一黑。

亚枫，又是他！

卡梅尔注意到周围不少记者都围了上来，拍着照，顿时就皱起眉头，拍了一下德兰克，低声道：

“赶紧处理了。”

他最后瞥了亚枫一眼，转身挤开人群离开。

德兰克叹了口气，走上前去。

亚枫看见他过来，低哼一声。

“德兰克，现在公司可真是没落啊，这种货色都能上桌了。”

德兰克看向罗文，对方已经被人搀扶了起来，正睁大眼睛看着他，好像在希望董事长能给自己站台。

德兰克却烦躁的冲他说道：“把手指捡起来！”

罗文咬了咬牙，满脸的悲愤，但看到亚枫，还是说不出一句话，上去将自己的断指捡了起来，

“送去医院。”

罗文被人送走，德兰克才看了亚枫一眼。

“跟我来。”

“走吧，伊尔莎。”

亚枫将餐刀丢下，跟着德兰克走去，伊尔莎连忙跟上他，人群也立马分开，生怕他再发疯。

寂静的后院。

“亚枫...你说你又惹什么事？之前都跟你说过多少次了，你一个普通人，魔法都不会，就少树敌了，现在有些人背后你都不知道对方是不是什么隐秘组织，到处惹是生非会遭来祸端的。”德兰克无奈至极的说道。

他可真不明白，亚枫一个普通人，或许也会点魔法，但怎么就敢到处惹事还活到现在的，他有时候都替他心急，可能也真是运气好罢了。

“而且今晚可还来了不少的报社，你说明天新闻又该怎么说了？”德兰克叹着气。

“没办法啊，之前你让我就这么算了我也就这么算了，今天他居然还敢在我面前跳，就实在没忍住，”亚枫摊摊手说道。

“不过反正我已经是死人一个了，随便怎么报告呗，过气名人精神失常，然后大闹晚会现场，反正过错都在我身上，没准还能给公司增加点热度。”亚枫说道。

德兰克瞥了他一眼，摇了摇头。

"Drank, thanks to your efforts in the past two years, from a small magazine to the current large group, I never expected that the changes would be so drastic."

"This is also thanks to your help, Minister Carmel." Derank said.

"Haha, I just played a supporting role." Carmel smiled lightly.

"It's just that it's best not to have things like that happen again. As you know, I even broke my legs running over there in the palace to suppress you." He continued.

"Yes...please rest assured that we are also strictly controlling the quality of content to ensure that similar accidents will not happen again." Derank said.

They walked downstairs together and came to the banquet hall.

Carmel sighed: "Well, it's good that we settled down with that ancestor. He caused us a lot of trouble. Thinking of him gives us a headache..."

"Yeah...he..." Before Delanke could finish his words, a heart-rending scream came from the other side of the banquet hall.

"What's going on?"

They quickly walked over together.

Entering the crowd, I heard a shout:

"Next time we meet, I'll give you another hand to stomp with!"

Rowan was lying on the ground, covering his hands and screaming. When Derank and Carmel saw clearly the man holding the knife, their eyes suddenly went dark.

Ya Feng, it’s him again!

Carmel noticed that many reporters had gathered around to take photos, and immediately frowned, patted Derank, and whispered:

"Handle it quickly."

He glanced at Ya Feng one last time, turned around and squeezed through the crowd to leave.

Derank sighed and stepped forward.

Ya Feng saw him coming and snorted.

"Drank, the company is really in decline now. This kind of stuff is on the table."

Derank looked at Rowan, who had been helped up and was looking at him with wide eyes, as if hoping that the chairman would give him a platform.

But Derank said to him irritably: "Pick up your fingers!"

Luo Wen gritted his teeth, his face full of grief and anger, but when he saw Ya Feng, he still couldn't say a word. He went up and picked up his severed finger.

"Send to hospital."

After Rowan was sent away, Delanke glanced at Yafeng.

"Follow me."

"Let's go, Ilsa."

Yafeng dropped the knife and followed Delank. Ilsa quickly followed him, and the crowd immediately separated, for fear that he would go crazy again.

Silent backyard.

"Yafeng...what trouble did you say you caused again? How many times have I told you before that you, an ordinary person, can't do magic, so you will make fewer enemies. Now you don't even know if there are some secret organizations behind some people. If you cause trouble everywhere, you will get into trouble." Delank said helplessly.

He really doesn't understand how Ya Feng, an ordinary person who may also know some magic, dares to cause trouble everywhere and is still alive. He sometimes feels anxious for him, maybe he is just lucky.

"And there are quite a few newspapers here tonight. What do you think the news will be like tomorrow?" Derank sighed.

"I can't help it. You asked me to forget it before, so I just let it go. Today he dared to jump in front of me. I really can't hold it back," Yafeng said, spreading his hands.

"But anyway, I'm already dead. You can report it however you want. A passing celebrity went insane and made a scene at the party. Anyway, the fault is all mine. Maybe it can add some heat to the company," Yafeng said.

Derank glanced at him and shook his head.
